hook: SHARING PASSWORDS Should we share passwords? No. Why?
transcript: Should we share passwords? No. Why? Why should we? Lots of couples do it for reassurance. If I want to hide something from you, I will. Sharing passwords won't stop it or build trust. It'll just give you a hundred harmless things to overthink. I agree. I don't want to overthink your emails.
on_screen_text: think you know your partner? find out.
sentence_pattern: short direct back and forth lines
